title: 🏦 Reinsurance Market Landscape — Indian Insurance AUM Crosses ₹74.44 Lakh Crore
summary: DFS Secretary M. Nagaraju addressed 3rd Global Reinsurance Summit in Mumbai. Total insurance premiums in FY25 reached ₹11.93L Cr with AUM of ₹74.44L Cr; reinsurance market stood at ₹1.12L Cr under "Insurance for All by 2047" vision.
